what: plastic.boss 10 across and 12 high with 4 ribs 1.5 thick, 6 out from the wall, 2 below the top, on a 60 x 60 x 3 plate
method: each rib is a 1.5-wide strip from r0/2 = 2.5 to r0 + 6 = 11 from the axis, 12 - 2 = 10 high from the face; outside the post (r0 = 5) its section is t(r0 + l) - [(t/2)sqrt(r0^2 - t^2/4) + r0^2 asin(t/(2 r0))] = 9.028220693 (the strip less the circle's part of it). V = 60*60*3 + pi*5^2*12 + 4*9.028220693*10 = 12103.606624
